The sealed record preserves row-level predictive evidence, model/provenance identities, specifications, calibration/statistical evidence, classification, traceability, access governance and chain of custody.
XAI was outside Sprint 54 execution and remained deferred with execution count zero.

PROTOCOL_INTERPRETATION.basis: The former are explicitly enumerated and sealed; the latter is absent and historical XAI readiness points to reconstruction. This is an interpretation of artifacts, not a proven contemporaneous motivation.
